correctness.rationale: The two-one normal form has unique nonnegative parameters a,b,c with sum N. Ordinary scattered 01 count is 2a+b; lex-minimal rotation is 0^L1 0^S1 with L=max(b,a+c), yielding count N+L. Only b=L or N-L can produce the observation, hence at most two parents. Opposite parities for odd N exclude collisions. For even N, the explicit (t,j)-pair construction is necessary and sufficient, with disjoint indexing, giving h(h+1)/2 doubletons and (h+1)^2 singleton fibers. N=0 is included. Independent literal-rotation enumeration of 39,711 words through N=60 matched every pair and count. Finite verification supports, rather than replaces, the proof.

evidence: A binary two-one word has three zero gaps, and its joint matrix observation is exactly the pair (2a+b,N+max(b,N-b)).
Reversal changes the first statistic from x to 2N-x, leaving the second unchanged; binary symbol swap leaves the fixed-two-one slice only in the special case N=2.
The 2020 article defines the Lyndon conjugate as the lexicographically smallest cyclic rotation, distinct from taking a Lyndon image within a Parikh class.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The relevant equivalent formulation is fixed-total-zero integer-point reconstruction from one linear and one max-linear measurement. It yields explicit doubletons only for even N. Searches using Parikh, Lyndon conjugate, sparse markers, and joint fiber terminology did not expose that equivalent classification. Reversal is a covariance of the observation, not an automatic equivalence of all observations.

originality.rationale: Relevant primary material from the 2020 proposal for the same joint observation was inspected and compared by implication. Its stated qualitative original-class distinguishability theorem does not yield the complete explicit collision-pair list and parity-specific counts. Search of exact aliases, relevant published mathematical records, and the accessible local claims did not find an equivalent assertion. Residual risks are explicitly acknowledged, especially the inaccessible 2021 expanded text.
residual_risks: The 2021 full-length journal text by the source authors was unavailable, so an equivalent sparse-layer specialization in its unobserved sections cannot be ruled out.
Some equations in the accessible 2020 indexed HTML article appeared as images and could not be inspected as text.
No global novelty or independent originality certification is claimed; the absence of retrieved matches is not a proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: This is a natural full classification of a published ambiguity-reduction measurement on sparse-marker binary strings, not an arbitrary small numeric slice. It gives an exact all-length reconstruction phase distinction by parity, all collision partners, exact singletons/doubletons and optimal noiseless encoding cardinality. The alternating odd-vs-even recoverability phenomenon has direct meaning for the proposed observation channel and is not established merely by the implementation or broad qualitative statements in the closest cited works.
